mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 6 months compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market anticipates accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines over 6 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 7.5%, it signals a weakening labor market that prompts the Federal Reserve to adopt accommodative monetary policy, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as investors price in rate cuts.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where UNRATE > 7.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate robust consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the market anticipates stronger corporate earnings.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS rise, or Rank IC for interaction term falls below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion regimes, a positive growth in real GDP (GDPC1) signals strong economic momentum that drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors expect sustained corporate profits.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances during late-cycle expansion when GDPC1 is positive, or regime-specific Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in housing starts (HOUST) indicates improving consumer confidence and economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as the market reacts to early signs of economic strength.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where HOUST rises, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 2.5%, it signals persistent inflationary pressures that prompt the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the market prices in higher interest rates.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 2.5% YoY, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and decreases in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicate a strong labor market, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the market anticipates higher consumer spending and corporate earnings.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances where PAYEMS rises and UNRATE falls, or Rank IC for interaction term falls below 0.03 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In post-recession recovery regimes, a sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals improving economic conditions, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as the market prices in the recovery.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances during post-recession recovery when PAYEMS rises, or regime-specific Rank IC falls below 0.03.
